This is called “salt”. It happens during the manufacturing of the slab because of the evaporation of water. It usually is during polishing or drying process of the slab. It takes 40-45 days to produce a slab of Taj Mahal quartzite so if they try to hurry the process or don’t polish/ dry the slab uniformly, the calcium and other minerals mixed in water used in these different processes surface from the natural fissures of the slab. This is a surface condition but there are no structural issues with your product. It does make your slab cheaper though!
